delete.description:
Permanently erase the account and every associated record (DPDP erasure).

Removes the credential, the cloud profile backup, the in-app alert inbox
and all registered push tokens. The client is expected to also wipe local
device state after a successful response.

ActivityWindow.title: ActivityWindow
ActivityWindow.description: A graded time slot for an activity within a day.

GeoPolygon.title: GeoPolygon
GeoPolygon.description: GeoJSON-style polygon (ring of [lon, lat] pairs, closed).

OtpRequest.title: OtpRequest
OtpRequest.description:
Ask the server to generate + deliver a one-time-password.

``contact`` is only needed when binding a contact during registration that
was not supplied there (it must match the account's own contact otherwise).

ProfileSync.title: ProfileSync
ProfileSync.description:
The mobile UserProfile payload used to move a profile between devices.

The client stores this locally (AsyncStorage) and can PUT it to the server,
then GET it back on another device to restore the same experience.

licence.title: Licence

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Attribution + validity carried on every piece of weather data/card.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
Create a mobile account that owns a synced profile across devices.

``email`` / ``phone`` are optional at registration but strongly advised:
they unlock OTP verification and self-serve password recovery (the only
way to recover an account today).

ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest
ResetPasswordRequest.description: Recover an account using a reset OTP instead of the old password.

SyncActivity.title: SyncActivity
SyncActivity.description: A scheduled activity on the mobile profile.

SyncLocation.title: SyncLocation
SyncLocation.description: A saved place (home/work/school/farm) on the mobile profile.
